capabilities: Render ABC notation code blocks as sheet music
Pass custom abcjs render options via JSON in the code block
Show error banners for invalid JSON options
extras: Maintained by the abcjs-music volunteer organization; full option reference is deferred to the official abcjs documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display music notation written in ABC inside notes.

relations.evidence: Under the hood it uses abcjs library and supports all the features that abcjs provides.

summary: Renders sheet music from code blocks tagged with the abc language specifier, using the abcjs library.
